authorization_basis: explicit approval of the fresh development attempt and standing setup-only continuation authority
authorization_scope: Explicitly authorized fresh development-stage attempt and setup-only startup recovery under the unchanged protocol, cohorts, thresholds, budgets, and ordering. This does not authorize scientific outcome rescue, regrading, or tuning, and does not itself provide stage admission or phase permits.
setup_failure_policy: Preserve every terminal setup refusal. A setup-only failure may be corrected and a new isolated attempt prepared under the same frozen contracts without a repeated approval prompt; use fresh stage and packet identities when an attempt has been consumed. Never reuse or carry forward a failed attempt. Scientific failure or inconclusive outcomes are retained and are not retried, rescued, regraded, or tuned.
